desc:
Punch, grab and throw your friends off the island! A quick 90-second party brawl of squishy shibas 🐕
Knock someone out for +100, throw them for +15. Top score when the timer ends wins.

■ 7 maps, each with its own twist (vote every round)
· Picnic Island: pass the hot potato, and watch out for the yanked blanket!
· Balloon Island: floor tiles crumble away
· Claw Machine: stay in a circle and dodge the claw's shadow
· Hot Air Baskets: get in a basket before the deck drops
· Toy Tower: the blocks shake and fall
· Toy Train: get off the flashing tracks
· Windy Rooftop: hold on to a pole when the gust hits

■ Controls (PC)
WASD move · Space jump · Click punch
Hold right-click = grab with both hands · E = lift, let go to throw
Click in the air = drop kick · Grab a wall + Space = climb · L = dance

■ Controls (phone)
Stick to move · Punch · Jump · Grab → Lift → Throw

Bring your friends and see who's the last shiba on the island!
